title: Ganesh Chathurthi celebration at temple went well! 🎉
summary: Click to view a glimpse of Tejomaya’s Ganesh Chathurthi celebrations. Thanks to all the coordinators and donors for making this happen. This weekend’s event awaits you!
body:
Tejomaya’s Ganesh Chathurthi celebration was a joyful and memorable occasion for our community. We hope you get some divine vibes from looking at our celebration pictures.

A heartfelt thank you to all the coordinators and donors for their time, effort, and generous support in making this celebration possible. We truly appreciate everyone who participated and contributed to its success.

Another exciting event awaits you this weekend. Stay tuned! 🎉

Thanks,
TOA.

title: Gym closed tomorrow! 🔒
summary: As per our recently published holiday list, our Gym will be closed tomorrow on the occasion of "Vinayagar Chathurthi". Advance Chathurthi wishes to all! 🙏
body:
Dear Residents,

As mentioned in our recently published holiday list, the gym will remain closed tomorrow on the occasion of Vinayagar Chathurthi.

We kindly request everyone to plan their workouts accordingly. Regular gym operations will resume after the holiday.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Wishing you and your family a happy and blessed Vinayagar Chathurthi in advance! 🙏

Thanks,
TOA.

title: "Drone Inspection" - ERL's external wall painting job
summary: We will be flying our 🚁 drones tomorrow between 10 a.m and 12 p.m. to inspect all the external walls of ABC Block. Please keep your curtains closed during this time.
body:
Dear Residents,

We will be flying our drones around ABC Block tomorrow between 10:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m. to inspect all the external walls of the building. This is just to ensure the quality of work delivered by ERL.

As the drones may fly close to windows and balconies during the inspection, we request all residents to keep their curtains closed throughout this period to maintain their privacy.

Please inform all members of your household about the inspection and take the necessary precautions. Your understanding and cooperation are greatly appreciated.

Thanks,
TOA.

title: 🏃‍♀️🎉 TOA Walks — Chapter 2 Winners!
summary: We’re happy to announce the winners of the "TOA Walks - Chapter 2" challenge. Open to see how the final standings turned out!
body:
45 days! 68 participants! 230 km!

Can’t believe that we have just finished the second instalment of our walking challenge as a healthy community. We are 100% sure that this challenge would have given you some undeniable health benefits. And have you ever noticed that you have pushed yourself beyond your limits to stay consistent? That’s what we wanted everyone to experience.
As we have learnt the art of staying consistent, let’s apply this to all our goals and passions. 

Until we meet again!

Thanks,
TOA.

title: External painting work is still ongoing!
summary: Owners of open parking spots in Tower A - West Side, Tower C - South Extreme End, and Stilt Level - South Side are requested to move their vehicles to a safer spot.
body:
Dear Residents,

Kindly move your parked vehicles from the specified areas until further notice. We have received an update from ERL that external painting work is still ongoing on their side. If you have already moved your vehicle, please continue parking it there until you hear back from us.

Work Details & Schedule:
- Timings: Daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM until the work is completed
- Areas: Tower A - West Side, Tower C - South Side Extreme End, and Stilt Level - South Side

Please move your vehicles at the earliest to avoid accidental paint splashes. Extremely sorry for all the inconvenience.

Regards,
TOA.
location: Tower A - West Side, Tower C - South Side Extreme End, and Stilt Level - South Side

title: Removal of Cycles, Flower Pots, etc..  from Corridors
summary: All tower residents are requested to remove their belongings from the corridors on their respective floors by tomorrow. Any items left behind will be removed.
body:
Removal of Cycles, Flower Pots & Other Items from Corridors (All Towers)

Dear Residents,

It has been observed that cycles, flower pots, and other personal items are being kept in the common corridors, obstructing free movement and posing a safety/fire-hazard risk to residents. All residents are requested to remove such items from the corridors on or before 10th September 2026.

Please note:
-⁠ Residents are requested to keep their belongings within their respective foyer area and not in common corridors.
-⁠ With effect from 10th September 2026, Housekeeping staff will remove all items left in the corridors, including cycles, flower pots, footwear racks, and any other personal belongings.
- The Association will not be responsible for any damage to items removed under this drive.

We seek your cooperation in keeping the corridors clear for the safety and convenience of all residents.

Regards,
TOA.

title: ⚠️ Vehicle Relocation for Painting Work
summary: Residents who own open parking spots on Tower A West Side, Tower C South Extreme End, and Stilt South Side must pay attention. Kindly relocate your cars/bikes.
body:
Dear Residents,

To avoid paint splashes and ensure the scheduled exterior painting work proceeds without delay, residents parking in the following zones are requested to temporarily shift their vehicles during working hours from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Tower A (West Side): Work will take place today and tomorrow.
Tower C (South Side - Extreme End): Work will take place today and tomorrow.
Stilt Level (South Side): Work will take place the day after tomorrow.

We appreciate your cooperation and support in helping us complete the work smoothly and on schedule. Kindly check the MyGate notice for parking zone images.

Regards,
TOA.
eventDate: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Today, Tomorrow & Day after tomorrow)
location: Tower A (West Side), Tower C (South Side - Extreme End) & Stilt Level (South Side)

title: MPH Hall Usage for Chathurthi Event Practice
summary: Air conditioning will be available daily from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM until 18 September for your convenience. At all other times, the hall is available without AC.
body:
Dear Residents,

We are happy to see so many of you enthusiastically participating in the Chathurthi event and practising for it. To make your practice sessions more comfortable, we have decided to turn on the AC daily between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM until 18th of September. Kindly plan your practice sessions accordingly.

You may also use the MPH at any other time without air conditioning.

Thanks,
TOA.
